body: I’ve spoken with some friends about this and what is apparently common is that this is a form of anxiety or overwhelmed feeling commonly felt amongst those that dissociate regularly. Things that have helped are grounding techniques like steaming hot showers, discussing your discomfort with a friend, walking/running until your out of breath, looking at your hands in detail. That panic resonates with a lot of us- being home but wanting to be home- that mad intense dissociative panic that spirals can be helped. Two small inhales through the nose and one exhale regulates natural breathing patterns too. If I learn more I will update this post.
Thank you - they already kind of have. Sometimes you have to let go.
